handoffs.message: Ready for review. Routes: /bff/capital-pools (GET/POST/GET-detail/PATCH/POST-action), /bff/ranking/formulas (GET/POST/GET-detail/PATCH/POST-action), /bff/rebalances (GET/POST/GET-detail/POST-action), /bff/rankings (GET/GET-detail/POST-action). Idempotency-Key required on writes. Action routes route through command_store with new CommandType.{CAPITAL_POOL,RANKING_FORMULA,REBALANCE,RANKING}_ACTION. Tests: services/control-plane/bff/test_bff_capital_ranking_rebalance_contract.py (23 tests). Full BFF suite passed (505 tests). Note: main.py/models.py/action_catalog.py edits got auto-bundled into BFF-LUV-GAP-008 commit (777533ee) by parallel worker; read_store.py and test file remain uncommitted for the closeout commit.

Review changes requested: (1) /bff/*/actions helper does not replay/conflict-check Idempotency-Key and duplicate same-key action submits two commands; (2) POST/PATCH /bff/capital-pools only returns an in-memory result and does not persist/update a readable pool, so created pool detail/action later 404s; (3) execute_plans_bff_routes.json still marks BFF-LUV-GAP-003 route rows missing/deferred. Focused test passed: pytest -q services/control-plane/bff/test_bff_capital_ranking_rebalance_contract.py.
